errScope: Twitch did not grant all required bot permissions. Authorize the bot again and approve every requested permission.
okBody: The bot account token was stored. You can close this tab.
errState: The authorization link expired or was invalid. Start bot authorization again.
errOauth: Twitch rejected the authorization. Try again.
errAccount: That Twitch account is not the configured bot account.
errConfig: Bot authorization is disabled until TWITCH_BOT_USER_ID is configured.
errSave: Twitch approved the bot, but ItsBagelBot could not save its token. Check the bot configuration and authorize the bot again.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Generate a new link and try again.
